newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Warehouse says sales up in 8 mths to March.
newsitem.headline: Warehouse says sales up in 8 mths to March.

text.p: New Zealand discount retailer The Warehouse Group Ltd said on Friday total sales for February and March were 16.4 percent ahead of those achieved for the corresponding period last year.
Same-store sales for the eight months ended March rose 4.5 percent.
The Warehouse noted that Easter occurred in the last week of March this year compared to early April for last year.

"The impact of removing these additional Easter sales from March would mean that total sales for February and March were 12.8 percent ahead of those achieved for the corresponding period last year and same store sales would be 3.8 percent ahead," the Warehouse said.
On Wednesday the Warehouse reported earnings of NZ$25.3 million for the six months to January, surprising most analysts, who had expected a result under $20 million.
Same store sales in that reporting period rose by 3.8 percent and totalled NZ$361.1 million.
